default/32713-3.htm.text: Pathfinder Worker: We have found out that Zaken has a way to manifest his Daytime presence to be even stronger than before. Our reports indicate that you can face him just like the regular Daytime Zaken, but it won't be easy. (Only level 78-85 can enter.)
